messages:
Jordan: Quick ask — can we hold merging PR #13014 (schema-change) until infra confirms the DB maintenance window? CI is green but we don't want a freeze overlap. @oncall @release :eyes:
Maya: Which window are we talking about?
Jordan: Infra calendar shows 2025-04-15 02:00–03:00 UTC but it might get adjusted.
Liam: FYI CI has a flaky linux/integration test. I cancelled a retry; I'll fix the test tonight. Also there's an unrelated clang-format change in the PR that makes rebase messy.
Maya: For process — add a /hold label and we'll treat it as blocked until DB sign-off. I can also propose a manual canary: merge to canary-1 and observe for 2h.
Sam: Heads up from release calendar: deploy-freeze starts 2025-04-15 00:00 UTC. We shouldn't land anything touching migrations after that. There's a rebase window around 03:30–04:00 UTC. Best to land before 00:00 or after 04:30.
Jordan: Got it. I'll split the migration out into a follow-up PR to keep this one small.
Liam: Splitting sounds good — smaller surface for QA. I'll re-review after you push the split.
Maya: I added the /hold label and pinged @qa. Jordan, please remove the label once you're ready for canary or final merge.
release-bot: NOTE: Freeze window scheduled 2025-04-15 00:00 -> 04:30 UTC. Merges that require DB coordination are flagged and will be blocked by merge-bot.
Jordan: Thanks. I'll create the follow-up PR and rebase tonight; will aim to request an expedited slot if we can't land before 00:00.
Sam: We do have a short pre-freeze slot at 2025-04-14 22:15 UTC tonight. If you need it, request it here and tag @release and @oncall with the runbook.
Jordan: Requesting that slot — filing PR comment now with risk rationale and rollback plan.
Maya: Noted. If CI goes green and infra/QA approve, we can grant the expedited slot. Otherwise keep /hold.
Liam: Small tip — when you're ready to merge, the gh CLI will be blocked by /hold. Command we'd run after removing hold: ```gh pr merge 13014 --squash --delete-branch```
Jordan: Copy. Will update PR, remove clang-format noise, and ping for reviews. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: QA checklist reminder — migrations must include rollback steps and a staging run documented in the PR before approval.
Jordan: Will attach staging logs and rollback script by EOD PST.
Sam: If anything changes with infra timing I'll update this thread and the calendar — ping me for any emergency slot changes.
Maya: Perfect. Leaving the hold in place until Jordan posts the split PR and QA confirms.
